title: Overnight no-knead loaf
notes: Edge-case example: no URL, a yield instead of servings, no ingredient groups or step sections, timers measured in hours, steps without `uses`, two background timers running together, and unknown fields that the app should ignore.

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.text: Stir 500 g bread flour, 10 g salt and ¼ tsp yeast in a large bowl. Add 400 ml lukewarm water and mix to a shaggy dough.

steps.title: Leave overnight
steps.text: Cover the bowl and leave it at room temperature overnight.
steps.cue: More than doubled, bubbly and wobbly.

steps.title: Shape the loaf
steps.text: Tip the dough onto a well-floured bench. Fold the edges into the middle to make a round, then turn it seam side down onto a sheet of baking paper.
steps.tip: Use floured hands. The dough is meant to be sticky.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.text: Cover loosely with a tea towel and leave to rise again. Heat the pot in the next step while it rises.
steps.cue: Puffy, and a fingertip dent springs back slowly.

steps.title: Heat the pot
steps.text: Put the lidded cast-iron pot in the oven and heat it to 240°C.

steps.title: Bake with the lid on
steps.text: Carefully lift the dough on its paper into the hot pot. Put the lid on and bake.
steps.tip: Oven gloves: the pot is very hot.

steps.title: Bake with the lid off
steps.text: Take the lid off and bake until the crust is deep brown.
steps.cue: Deep brown, and it sounds hollow when tapped underneath.

steps.title: Cool before slicing
steps.text: Lift the loaf onto a wire rack and leave it to cool before cutting.
